evidence.quote: We provide our employees with a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including in-person, virtual, social and self-directed learning, mentoring, coaching and external development.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Growth and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

community.criterion: level 2: specific current community investment, no reach figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Philanthropic grantmaking through the Okta for Good Fund, a donor-advised fund
evidence.quote: We also engage in philanthropic grantmaking via the Okta for Good Fund, a donor-advised fund held at Tides Foundation.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Community and Social Impact

community.criterion: level 2: named grantmaking fund, no dollar or recipient figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Okta for Good connects employees with giving and volunteering opportunities
evidence.quote: Our employees are passionate about many causes and Okta for Good connects them with numerous giving and volunteering opportunities in service of our communities.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Community and Social Impact

community.criterion: level 2: employee volunteering and giving program, no participation or dollar figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Inclusive employee benefits, including gender-neutral paid parental leave and fertility and adoption support
evidence.quote: charitable donation matching, flexible time off, volunteer time off, gender-neutral paid parental leave, fertility and adoption support, family care resources
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Compensation, Benefits and Wellness

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: inclusive benefits, no reach figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Regular equal pay assessments to promote pay equity across employees
evidence.quote: We conduct regular equal pay assessments to attempt to promote pay equity among all of our employees.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Compensation, Benefits and Wellness

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific internal equity practice, no figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Sells identity software to customers that include small- and medium-sized businesses
evidence.quote: These customers consist of leading global organizations ranging from the largest enterprises to small- and medium-sized businesses, universities, nonprofits and government agencies.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: small-business customers with no specific enabling service

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers identity and security software in detail and shows no creative, artistic or storytelling activity; developer tools and software design are engineering, not creative work.

community.reason: Level 2: specific current community investment through Okta for Good (donated and discounted service, grantmaking fund, employee giving and volunteering) plus employee development, but no participant, dollar or recipient figures show substantial reach.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal practices (gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption support, regular equal pay assessments) with no reach figures.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: small- and medium-sized businesses appear only as customers, with no specific program or tool aimed at barriers to starting or growing a business.

ai.notes: The Okta for Good mission statement ('build a safely connected world where everyone can belong and thrive') is aspirational language and was not scored on its own. The filing refers to the Okta for Good web page for more information, but it also describes specific activities itself, so Community coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. Item 7 lists charitable contributions only as a component of G&A expense, with no amount, so it adds no figure. The benefits in E5 'may vary by country or region', so they may not apply to all employees. Excluded items: the Okta Community online forum, the Oktane conference and customer product training (customer support and marketing, not external education); free and self-service Auth0 developer plans and the Auth0 Marketplace (not described as aimed at founders or small businesses); 'innovate' language (trap); Okta for AI Agents and Cross App Access (early access, not relevant to any theme). International revenue (20%) and offices outside the US do not count for Cross-cultural.
